title: SNI twin_record.v1
description: R1-gated DRAFT of one append-only Single-Name Intelligence reference-twin record. SNI-local contract that CONSUMES owner-supplied payload, owner_key, owner_digest and clocks; it does not fork Data OS identity, Company Event/Earnings, FIF, Capital Structure, Stock Identity, Options, Research Vault, or qledger/Evaluation. twin_key and any identity ids are caller-supplied opaque strings; this schema never mints HK/US issuer or security identifiers. Qualification/record facts only; never a signal, score, rank, gate, size, escalation or trade. Every authority flag is const false.

record_id.description: sha256 hex of canonical JSON of {twin_key, generation, owner_key, owner_digest, clocks, supersedes}.

twin_key.description: Opaque caller-supplied twin key. Never constructed from a ticker, name, code or CIK.

supersedes.description: record_id of the prior generation of this twin_key, or null for generation 1.

owner_key.description: Registry key of the owner that supplied the payload. Not an identity id.

owner_digest.description: sha256 hex of canonical_json(payload) as the OWNER computed it (A15).

payload.description: Owner-supplied body, consumed as given. Must not contain authority flag keys.

prev_hash.description: row_hash of the previous JSONL line, or null at the start of the file. Filled by the store.

row_hash.description: sha256 hex of canonical_json(record without row_hash). Filled by the store.
